hypothesis: coins whose open interest per unit of traded dollar volume grew fastest over the trailing 28d subsequently underperform low/flat-OI-growth coins on a beta-neutral weekly Binance USD-M perpetual book, after adapter costs and native funding (deleveraging/liquidation-friction premium)
literature_honesty_note: no peer-reviewed paper directly prices the cross-section of crypto open-interest growth; the claim is a novel transfer resting on a verified mechanism-friction chain (P5, P6), one time-series positioning-predictability prior (P7), perp mechanics (P8) and a mandatory OI data-quality constraint (P9). Higher external-validity risk than a direct-pricing transfer, declared per packet rule 1.
mechanism: rapid OI build-up per unit volume marks newly over-levered books that (i) transiently overprice the coin and (ii) raise the probability of mechanically amplified forced selling (deleveraging cascade, endogenous-buildup type); shorting that fragility and longing the un-levered alternative earns the deleveraging premium; counterparty is over-leveraged late directional retail

feature_contract.bars: completed 15m base bars only (close, quote volume)
feature_contract.oi: per-symbol open-interest snapshots from the frozen staged snapshot, last publish-timestamp strictly inside each completed UTC day
feature_contract.aggregate: daily UTC close, daily dollar volume, daily last-OI
feature_contract.anchor_feature: OILEV_FLOW_28D = log change over 28d of OI_i/daily_dollar_volume_i (leverage build-up flow, volume-normalised)
feature_contract.neighbour_feature: OILEV_STOCK = trailing 56d mean of OI_i/daily_dollar_volume_i (standing leverage intensity level)
feature_contract.contamination_diagnostic: declared pre-score: rank correlation of OILEV_FLOW_28D vs trailing 28d price return (momentum-smuggling check)
feature_contract.residualisation: rolling 90d daily beta vs BTC applied to book weights (beta-neutral)
feature_contract.pit_lag: features from completed bars and timestamped OI snapshots only; 24h declared execution lag; weekly decision instant
feature_contract.funding_role: cost line only, never a signal input (keeps family outside funding-carry/crowding adjacency by construction)
feature_contract.oi_data_quality_gate: P9 fail-closed plausibility gate per symbol: non-negative OI, no >50% level gaps in window, no unexplained >10x level jumps; failures mark the feature UNAVAILABLE for the instant (never inferred)

anchor.name: OILEV-FLOW-28D-W
anchor.book: long lowest-OI-growth quintile minus short highest-OI-growth quintile, equal weight, dollar-neutral, beta-neutral

neighbour.name: OILEV-STOCK-56D-W
neighbour.book: same book on the leverage-stock level feature

causal_negative_control.name: OILEV-FLOW-28D-W-INV
causal_negative_control.book: sign-inverted anchor (long most newly-levered minus short least)
causal_negative_control.falsification: any positive after-cost spread on the inverted book destroys the mechanism claim (it would imply OI build-up predicts continuation, not deleveraging drag)

schedule.turnover_rationale: OI is a slow stock variable; 28d trailing feature on a weekly clock with persistent bucket membership; A3 verifies all floors on schedule artifacts before scoring

expected_sign: anchor net spread > 0; neighbour same sign, weaker; inverted control <= 0
falsification_conditions: anchor net spread negative or ~0 (cross-sectional transfer fails)
neighbour sign opposite to anchor (differencing artefact)
anchor edge fully explained by momentum contamination diagnostic with failed A7-N orthogonality
A3 floors fail (base drag > 8%/yr, stressed > 12%/yr, holding < 3d, decisions > 60/365d, symbol turnover share > 25%)
OI coverage/plausibility too thin (UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED, never traded through)
cost_treatment: adapter taker fee + adverse-tick slippage floor per side via GenericStrategyBase.rebalance_cost_between; stressed cell fee x1.5 + 2 ticks; native 8h funding accrual via checked_funding_accrual; short high-OI leg typically receives funding - funding attribution reported separately so the tailwind cannot masquerade as mechanism edge
risks: OI misquoting at major venues (P9): binding data-quality risk, mitigated only by the fail-closed gate
exogenous-shock cascades (P6: 2 of 7 events) are NOT predicted by positioning - part of the honest null
novel transfer with no direct cross-sectional pricing prior (higher external-validity risk, disclosed)
momentum contamination (mitigated by declared pre-score diagnostic + A7-N rho gate)
funding tailwind on the short leg could be misattributed (separate attribution disclosure)
spot-universe literature absent entirely; priors are BTC time-series - universe transfer risk
